newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index rises 3 points to 739.4 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index rises 3 points to 739.4 pts.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, rose three points on Wednesday to 739.4 points, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Four of the ten sectoral indices rose, with the energy index rising the most, up 9.4 points to 893.4.
Six indices lost, with the machinery and banking indices losing the most, down 12 points to 881.7, or 1,126.4 respectively.
